svg.text: Winter against summer at station TMU (broadband sensor)
Every hour of January 2026 and of July 2026.
Lines: the median hour; shading: from the 10% quietest to the 10% noisiest hours. Dashed: Peterson's models.
Two sensors side by side at station SRU (October 2026)
A 1 Hz geophone and a broadband seismometer at the same site, every hour of the month.
Lines: the median hour; shading: from the 10% quietest to the 10% noisiest hours. Dashed: Peterson's models.
